prompts: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the supplied transparent portrait cutout of Shixin Wu holding a sunflower and rose bouquet. Make two subtle photographic corrections only. 1. Her hair currently looks unnaturally crisp with too many individually sharpened bright strands; soften the hair microcontrast and the wispy outer cutout edges so the hair reads as naturally soft, sunlit photographic hair, while retaining the actual hairstyle, bangs and full rounded crown. Preserve detail without plastic smoothing or a blurry head. 2. Add a delicate translucent diagonal rainbow refraction from the upper-right temple across the right cheek and gently toward the bridge of the nose, as sunlight passing through a car window/prism. The rainbow should be softly diffused, warm, low-opacity with muted red/gold/green/blue, believable reflected light rather than face paint, and it must leave the eyes and facial features clearly visible. Let the warm lighting tie naturally to the existing sunlight on the hair. Preserve this exact facial identity, face proportions, expression, head tilt, pose, white shirt, all bouquet flowers, hands, body and framing. Do not retouch or reshape facial features. Keep the entire completed head visible. Keep the same portrait dimensions and foreground placement so it drops into the existing website layout. Maintain true alpha transparency outside the person and bouquet; do not introduce car scenery, colored backdrop, checkerboard, text, logos, frame, or detached lens flare outside the foreground.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the HAIR in this supplied transparent portrait cutout. Keep the face and its subtle rainbow light, facial identity, expression, flowers, bouquet, shirt, body, alpha transparency and composition exactly unchanged. The hair is still far too sharply detailed and wire-like, especially the individual golden flyaway strands along both outer edges and the upper crown. Give the entire hair visibly softer photographic focus, lower clarity and much lower strand-level contrast: merge the tiny bright wire-like strands into naturally soft broad locks, reduce golden edge highlights, remove the crunchy sharpened outline, and create a gently feathered natural alpha edge. This should look like a normal slightly soft phone photograph, with no drawn or CGI individual hair wires. Maintain the hair's dark color, bangs, volume and complete rounded crown, and leave the face sharp and recognizable. Do not blur the eyes, face, sunflower or roses. No background, text, frame, glow border or new objects. True transparent background, same portrait dimensions and pose.
